title: MapleStory: Idle RPG Official Gameplay FAQ
author: MapleStory: Idle RPG Team
summary: The maintained official reference for job changes, reset schedules, boosters, idle earnings, currencies, equipment slots, account access, purchases, and technical recovery.

sections.title: Progression and daily play
items: Job changes unlock after level 40 and second job advancement, with a 24-hour restriction after changing.
Daily, weekly, and monthly reset schedules follow each server's time zone.

sections.title: Rewards and equipment
items: Offline rewards accumulate for a limited period and must be claimed before expiry.
Shoulder, ring, pendant, and face-accessory sources differ and unlock through progression.

sections.title: Account and device safety
items: Link guest accounts before clearing data or reinstalling.
Use official stores, keep the OS updated, and provide device evidence when contacting support.

notes: Structured MPStorys reading edition of the maintained official FAQ, verified on 2026-07-27.
steps: Identify the relevant gameplay, purchase, account, or technical section.
Check the listed unlock requirement or reset time.
Follow the official steps and warnings.
Re-check the source after major updates.
